title: I wish I knew
author: Gus
body:
## *I wish I knew...*

sam's pizza was such a good time especially when I discovered HKCR it was honestly mesmerizing! Online threat, Heman, Fingergap. It was all peak seriously!

![](../Editorial-images/20200626081626.gif "Sam's love")

This gif and the original photo was from my time at Sam's pizza when I delivered. I miss that job but the wear on the car is not worth it. back then I think I enjoyed the job but when winter came it became a bit difficult to manage with school so I dropped sam's late October.
